title: The School Report — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The school report arrives in an envelope in December
With the assessment of the year and the things to remember
For improvement — and the teacher's handwriting is unchanged
From every teacher's handwriting since the era was arranged

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El boletín de notas llega en un sobre en diciembre
[The school report arrives in an envelope in December]
Con la evaluación del año y lo que hay que tener en cuenta siempre
[With the assessment of the year and what to remember always]
Para mejorar — y la letra del maestro no cambia nunca
[For improvement — and the teacher's handwriting never changes]
Desde que existió la escritura en el aula de la encrucijada
[Since writing existed in the classroom at the crossroads]

[Chorus — English]
The school report knows something I don't know
It knows the official version of the year's particular flow
The school report identifies the strengths and where they're going
And gets the direction approximately right but not the growing
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le bulletin scolaire arrive dans une enveloppe en décembre
[The school report arrives in an envelope in December]
Avec l'évaluation de l'année et les choses à retenir pour l'hiver
[With the assessment of the year and the things to remember for winter]
Et l'écriture de l'enseignant est inchangée depuis toujours
[And the teacher's handwriting is unchanged since forever]
Le bulletin scolaire décrit l'enfant mais pas ses jours
[The school report describes the child but not their days]

[Outro — All three languages]
School report knows… El boletín sabe… Le bulletin sait
The potential is always right — El potencial siempre tiene razón — Le potentiel a toujours raison
That's my boy
